summary: A new command queues one reminder notice per member with overdue loans, and reads the outbox to space reminders.

expected_correction.why: Its need states a rule the developer did not mean, on purpose: no member reminded twice on the same day, where they mean 7 days or more between two reminders of a member. A session that takes the need at its word plans the first, and what the case evaluates is that the error is caught when the developer reads the blueprint.
